definition: LLaVA-CoT is a multimodal reasoning model used in this archive by CoRAP, a conformal-prediction framework for statistically valid uncertainty sets over reasoning-answer pairs, and by Heima, which replaces each stage of a multimodal chain-of-thought with a single learned latent 'thinking token' expandable back into readable reasoning.

evidence.note: CoRAP is a conformal-prediction framework that constructs statistically valid uncertainty sets over reasoning-answer pairs for large reasoning models (guaranteeing a correct answer supported by valid reasoning is covered with a user-specified probability), paired with a Shapley-value-based example-to-step explanation method that provably identifies which training examples and reasoning steps are sufficient to achieve that coverage.
evidence.title: Quantifying and Understanding Uncertainty in Large Reasoning Models

evidence.note: Heima replaces each stage of a multimodal model's textual chain of thought with a single learned 'thinking token' generated in latent space, and trains a separate decoder that can expand those tokens back into readable reasoning.
evidence.title: Efficient Reasoning with Hidden Thinking

name: LLaVA-CoT
